arguments.name: copy_type
arguments.description: Copy one source directory ('single') or several mappings ('multi').

arguments.name: source
arguments.description: Source directory whose contents are copied; required when copy_type is 'single'.

arguments.name: destination
arguments.description: Destination directory; required when copy_type is 'single'.

arguments.name: mappings
arguments.description: List of {source, destination} directory pairs; required when copy_type is 'multi'.

arguments.name: replace_rules
arguments.description: Rules routing matching files into a destination subfolder and replacing older versions: each {source glob, destination relative folder, version_pattern regex with a named 'version' group}.

arguments.name: backup
arguments.description: Back up destination files before they are overwritten.

arguments.name: max_files
arguments.description: Number of backups kept when rotating by max_files.

arguments.name: max_timestamp
arguments.description: Age of backups kept when rotating by max_timestamp, in max_timestamp_unit.
